description: These handmade floating coconut shell candles bring a touch of tropical elegance and spiritual ambience to your home. Perfect for creating a serene atmosphere during festivals, meditation sessions, or special occasions, these floating candles are designed to attract positive energy and prosperity into your living space. The natural coconut shell base adds an authentic, rustic charm whilst the colourful frangipani blooms create a stunning visual display when floating on water. Ideal for decorating traditional urli bowls, these candles transform any space into a peaceful sanctuary. Whether you're celebrating Diwali, hosting a puja ceremony, or simply seeking to enhance your home's spiritual energy, these handcrafted floating candles offer both aesthetic appeal and symbolic significance. The combination of natural materials and vibrant colours makes each piece unique, adding character to your festive decorations or daily rituals. Place them in water-filled bowls or urlis to create a mesmerising floating effect that captivates guests and elevates your home décor with traditional Indian charm.
